copy.beads.intro: Announce the mystery, then pray the Our Father on the larger bead. Pray a Hail Mary on each of the ten smaller beads while meditating on the mystery. Finish with the Glory Be; the Fatima prayer is optional.
copy.beads.imageDescription: An original teaching illustration of bronze and cream beads, shown left to right. This is a single decade, not a complete Rosary.
copy.beads.practiceIntro: Use Next bead as you pray. Previous bead goes back; Start again returns to the larger bead.
copy.beads.caption: This shows one decade, not the full five-decade Rosary.
copy.beads.imageTitle: One decade: one Our Father bead followed by ten Hail Mary beads
copy.beads.ourFatherStatus: Our Father. Begin on the larger bead.
copy.beads.heading: Follow one decade
copy.beads.hailMaryStatus: Hail Mary {n} of 10. Pray a Hail Mary on the highlighted bead.
copy.beads.completeStatus: Decade complete. Pray the Glory Be, then the Fatima prayer if you wish.
